svg.title: SepFormer — detailed architecture
svg.text: Flatten consecutive epochs to one waveform.
Strided Conv1d and activation produce latent time frames.
LayerNorm and linear projection; overlapping feature
Chunks are feature-space windows, not individual EEG
Residual paths preserve features; repeated configurable
Each attention stack also has a whole-stack residual.
PReLU / Linear before overlap-add; feed-forward / ReLU
Elementwise multiply the mask and original analysis
Transposed convolution; adjust padding and length.
Reshape to epoch context and select the centre epoch.
Analysis encoder → Normalise and chunk · flow
Normalise and chunk → Dual-path Transformers · flow
Dual-path Transformers → Overlap-add and mask · flow
Overlap-add and mask → Mask encoded features · flow
Mask encoded features → Waveform decoder · flow
Analysis encoder → Mask encoded features · skip: Original analysis features
Experimental paper_accurate package; this depicts repository behavior, not a claim of complete
